jobs.title: $22.50HR/ RETAIL STORES UNARMED SECURITY OFFICER SEASONAL WORK STRTS SEPT
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a vigilant and dedicated Unarmed Security Officer to uphold safety and security across our premises. In this dynamic role, you will be the first line of defense, ensuring a secure environment through proactive surveillance, access control, and customer service. Your presence will help maintain order, prevent incidents, and foster a safe atmosphere for staff, visitors, and property. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to apply your security expertise while contributing to a safe community.

Duties

  • Monitor surveillance systems such as CCTV to detect suspicious activity and ensure property security.
  • Conduct regular patrols of the premises, including buildings, parking lots, and restricted areas to identify potential security threats.
  • Control access points using access control systems, verifying identities and authorizations of employees, visitors, and contractors.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations following established procedures, including fire alarms or medical emergencies.
  • Write detailed incident reports documenting any security breaches, accidents, or unusual occurrences for record-keeping and future reference.
  • Perform background checks on new personnel or visitors as part of security screening processes.
  • Assist with conflict de-escalation and conflict management to maintain a peaceful environment while adhering to security regulations.

Skills

  • Strong surveillance skills with experience operating CCTV and other monitoring equipment.
  • Knowledge of law enforcement procedures and emergency response protocols.
  • Ability to perform manual handling tasks safely, including heavy lifting when necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with the public.
  • Proficiency in incident report writing with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as Taser devices (non-lethal), AEDs (Automated External Defibrillators), and fire extinguishers.
  • Understanding of physical security measures including patrolling techniques and access control systems.
  • Ability to perform first aid procedures including CPR and AED operation confidently.
  • Experience in performing background checks and ensuring compliance with security regulations.
  • Strong conflict de-escalation skills combined with effective communication for conflict management situations.

Join us as a Unarmed Security Officer and become an integral part of maintaining a safe, secure environment where safety is our top priority!

Embark on this seasonal journey where your expertise makes a real difference! We value energetic professionals committed to safety and community well-being. Join us in creating a secure environment that allows everyone to enjoy the festivities confidently.

Pay: Up to $45.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Officer Retail - Memorial
jobs.description:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.



Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Retail - Memorial in Houston, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $16.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTime
Sun06:00 AM - 02:00 PM

How This Role Works:

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer service to shoppers, associates, and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, location-specific policies, and, when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents, customer concerns, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, escalating matters according to established procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout the retail location, including sales areas, entrances, parking areas, and perimeter, to help deter unauthorized activity and identify potential concerns.
  • Monitor access points, observe activity within assigned areas, and report suspicious activity, hazards, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Document incidents, observations, and patrol activities accurately and maintain professional communication with store personnel, visitors, and responding agencies.

Minimum Requirements:

  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
